scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "${npm_config_user_agent:-}" in pnpm/*) ;; npm/*pnpm*) ;; "") ;; *) echo "Warning: Use pnpm instead of ${npm_config_user_agent}" >&2 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
